about: Conformance vectors of the transition timeline command.

vectors.name: centred on the cut: the clips use their handles and nothing else moves (a song across the cut on a sync-locked track, a caption and a marker stay)
start at the cut: only the outgoing clip runs on past it
end at the cut: only the incoming clip starts before it
an odd length centred: the extra frame comes after the cut
linked: false gives only the named clip's cut a transition
fade_black is stored as dip_to_black
a new length starts again from the cut
a new alignment starts again from the cut
another kind keeps the cut, the length and the alignment
cut gives both clips back exactly as they were at the cut
hidden output comes first: a clip cut from a longer one shows its own frames again
too few handle frames: the media that is missing repeats the edge frame (insufficient media)
removing a transition that repeated frames takes the freezes and the source frames back
whole takes have no handles: both clips hold their edge frames
removing it leaves whole takes again
speed and frame step: handles come in whole source frames and whole drawings, the rest is held
text layers lend frames on both sides and never repeat one
removing it gives the text layers back exactly
an older transition (no recorded cut) changes from the middle of its overlap
removing an older transition keeps the length: the middle of its overlap becomes the cut
an older transition of odd length: the extra frame of its overlap goes with the outgoing clip
another kind on an older transition records its cut and keeps its frames
the last clip has nothing to fade into
longer than the shorter clip
a gap is no cut to put a transition on
a locked track refuses
a fade-out moves when frames are held after it: the outgoing clip cannot run on without media
impact frames start on the incoming clip's first frame: it cannot start earlier without media
cut has no alignment
a cut into an adjustment layer takes no transition
an adjustment layer takes no transition into the next clip
